entries.title: Psalms 104:1
segments: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, You are very great; You have put on honor and majesty,

entries.title: Psalms 104:2
segments: covering Yourself [with] light as with a robe; and stretching out the heavens like a curtain;

entries.title: Psalms 104:3
segments: He lays the beams [of] His upper rooms in the waters. He sets the clouds [as] His chariots; He walks on the wings of the wind;

entries.title: Psalms 104:4
segments: He makes His angels spirits, His ministers a flaming fire.

entries.title: Psalms 104:5
segments: He laid the earth on its foundations; it shall not be shaken forever.

entries.title: Psalms 104:6
segments: You covered the deep as with a robe; the waters stand above the mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 104:7
segments: At Your rebuke they flee; at the voice of Your thunder they hurry away.

entries.title: Psalms 104:8
segments: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys to the place which You have founded for them.

entries.title: Psalms 104:9
segments: You have set a bound that they may not pass over, so that they do not turn again to cover the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:10
segments: [He] sends the springs into the valleys; they flow between the hills.

entries.title: Psalms 104:11
segments: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild asses break their thirst.

entries.title: Psalms 104:12
segments: By them the birds of the heavens will have their place of rest; they sing among the branches.

entries.title: Psalms 104:13
segments: [He] waters the hills from His upper rooms; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.

entries.title: Psalms 104:14
segments: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for the service of man, to bring forth food out of the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 104:15
segments: and wine cheers the heart of man, and oil makes his face shine, and bread sustains the heart of man.

entries.title: Psalms 104:16
segments: The trees of the LORD [are] full, the cedars of Lebanon which He has planted;

entries.title: Psalms 104:17
segments: where the birds make their nests; the fir trees [are] the house of the stork.

entries.title: Psalms 104:18
segments: The high hills [are] for the wild goats, and the rocks [are] a refuge for the badgers.

entries.title: Psalms 104:19
segments: He appointed the moon for seasons; the sun knows its going down.

entries.title: Psalms 104:20
segments: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the beasts of the forest creep forth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:21
segments: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

entries.title: Psalms 104:22
segments: The sun rises; they are gathered, and go to their dens to lie down.

entries.title: Psalms 104:23
segments: Man goes out to his work and to his labor until the evening.

entries.title: Psalms 104:24
segments: O LORD, how many are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your riches.

entries.title: Psalms 104:25
segments: This [is] the great and wide sea, in which [are] creeping things without number, both small and great animals.

entries.title: Psalms 104:26
segments: There the ships go; You made this great sea animal to play in it.

entries.title: Psalms 104:27
segments: These all wait on You, that You may give them their food in due season.

entries.title: Psalms 104:28
segments: You give to them, they gather; You open Your hand; they [are] filled with good.

entries.title: Psalms 104:29
segments: You hide Your face, they [are] troubled; You take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.

entries.title: Psalms 104:30
segments: You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; and You renew the face of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:31
segments: The glory of the LORD shall endure forever; the LORD shall rejoice in His works.

entries.title: Psalms 104:32
segments: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the hills, and they smoke.

entries.title: Psalms 104:33
segments: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

entries.title: Psalms 104:34
segments: My thoughts of Him shall be sweet; I will be glad in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 104:35
segments: Let the sinners perish from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD!
